Not quite yet. The saving, search, and reading flows are well captured, but “manage bookmarks” still needs a few important areas settled before building:

- I need to delete a bookmark permanently, and separately archive one so it disappears from the normal list and ordinary searches but can be restored from an Archive view.
- I need to select several bookmarks and add or remove tags, mark read or unread, archive, or delete them together. I’d also like the option to apply an action to every result in the current search or view—not bookmarks outside that filter.
- I need sorting, at least by date added and title.
- Notes should support simple formatting and display that formatting when viewed.
- I want a preserved copy of a saved page. For a normal page that should be a self-contained saved page; for a PDF, it should preserve the PDF itself. I’d also like the option to send a page to the Internet Archive.
- I’d like reusable saved searches that can combine search text with tags to include or exclude.
- I need to import and export a standard browser-bookmarks file while retaining titles, tags, and original saved dates.
- Finally, I’d like basic display preferences such as default sorting, how many items are shown, and text size.

Please walk me through these before implementation so we don’t lock in an incomplete first version.
